sentences.text: Hello everyone. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. I am Emily. Today, we will talk about Shiraz.
Shiraz is a city in Iran. It is very old and very beautiful. Many people visit Shiraz every year.
Shiraz has many gardens and flowers. The weather in Shiraz is warm and summer and cool and winter.
People are very friendly. You can see many colors in the city. Houses are colorful and the streets are
clean. Shiraz is famous for its history and culture. Many tourists come to see old buildings and
beautiful gardens. You can take photos of the city. People like to walk in the streets and enjoy
the views. In Shiraz, you can meet kind people. They like to talk and share stories about their city.
You can also drink tea and eat local food in small cafes. Shiraz is a good city for tourists.
You can feel history, art and nature. Let's learn more about Shiraz in the next part.
Part 2. History of Shiraz. Shiraz is an ancient city. It is more than 2,000 years old.
Long ago, kings and poets lived here. Shiraz was the city of learning, art and culture.
People studied science and literature in Shiraz. Many old buildings are still in the city.
Some buildings are very famous for their architecture. They are made with beautiful colors and designs.
You can see old mosques, houses and gardens. Shiraz was also a center for trade. People from
other cities came to Shiraz to sell and buy goods. Markets were full of colors and smells.
Today, people can visit historical sites. You can learn about old kings and poets. History
in Shiraz is very interesting. You can feel the past when you walk in the city. Shiraz is a city
of culture and tradition. It shows the life of people from long ago. Visiting Shiraz is
like walking in history. Part 3. Famous people from Shiraz. Shiraz is famous for poets.
Hafez and Sadi are two very famous poets. They lived many years ago.
People visit their tombs in Shiraz to remember them.
Hafez wrote poems about love, life and nature. People read his poems every day.
Sadi also wrote poems about kindness and friendship. Shiraz is also famous for artists and writers.
Many people in Shiraz like music and painting. The city has art galleries and small museums.
You can see paintings and sculptures in Shiraz. People in Shiraz are proud of their poets.
They learn poems at school. Tourists also like to read poems in the gardens and streets.
Art and poetry are important in Shiraz. You can feel beauty everywhere in the city.
It is a place of inspiration. Part 4. Gardens and nature.
Shiraz has many beautiful gardens. The most famous is Aram Garden. It has many flowers,
trees and water. The garden is calm and colorful. People like to walk there.
There are other gardens too. Each garden has flowers and trees.
People sit on benches and relax. Children play in some gardens. In spring,
flowers bloom and the city looks very beautiful. Birds sing and water flows in small canals.
People take photos of nature. Gardens are very important in Shiraz. They show the love of people
for nature. If you like quiet places, gardens are very nice. You can drink tea and gardens
and enjoy the fresh air. Nature in Shiraz is peaceful and relaxing. Part 5. Famous buildings.
Shiraz has many old buildings. One of the most famous is Nasir al-Mulk Mosque. It has colorful
windows. When the sun shines, the colors are very beautiful. Other famous buildings are Karim
Consideredel and Vakil Mosque. They are old and interesting. You can see history in every stone.
People visit these places to take photos. Many tourists like to see old Persian architecture.
Buildings in Shiraz are very beautiful. You can also see traditional houses. Some houses have gardens inside.
The city is full of history and art. Visiting buildings in Shiraz is like traveling back in time.
You can feel the life of people long ago. Part 6. Food in Shiraz.
Shiraz has very tasty food. One famous dish is Kalampolo. Rice with cabbage. Another is
dizzy. Meat and vegetables cooked slowly. People also like fresh fruits. Pomegranates, oranges,
and grapes are very common. Sweet desserts are also popular. You can eat food in small restaurants
or at home. People like to share food with family and friends. Tea is very popular. People drink tea
every day. Markets in Shiraz sell fresh vegetables, fruits, and spices. Food is colorful and delicious.
Tourists like to try local dishes. Eating in Shiraz is a good way to feel the culture.
You can taste many flavors and enjoy the city.
Part 7. The People of Shiraz. People in Shiraz are friendly and kind. They smile a lot.
Many people speak Persian. Some people speak English too. People wear different clothes.
Some wear traditional clothes. In the markets, people sell fruit, food, and clothes. Life in Shiraz is calm.
Children play in the streets. Families walk in gardens. People like to meet friends and drink tea.
People of Shiraz are proud of their city. They like to share their culture with tourists.
You can feel their kindness everywhere. Visiting Shiraz is nice because people are helpful and
friendly. You can make friends and learn about their life. Part 8. Shiraz Market.
Shiraz has a big market. It is called Vaquil Bazaar. You can buy carpets, spices, and souvenirs.
The market is full of colors and smells. People sell different things. Some sell jewelry, clothes,
or handmade goods. Tourists like to visit the market. You can also taste local food.
The market is busy in the morning. People walk slowly and talk with sellers.
You can buy gifts for friends and family. Markets in Shiraz are very traditional. They show the life
of people. Walking in the market is fun. You can take photos and enjoy the sounds of the city.
Markets are a good place to learn about Shiraz. Part 9. Festivals in Shiraz. Shiraz has many
festivals. One big festival is Nauruz, the Persian New Year. It is in spring. People celebrate with
flowers, food, and music. People wear traditional clothes. Children play and families meet. Music
and dancing are very important. Other festivals are about religion and culture. People visit mosques
and gardens. Festivals are happy times in Shiraz. Tourists like to join festivals.
You can see colors, music, and traditional food. Festivals are a way to feel the culture.
Shiraz is lively during festivals. People enjoy life and celebrate together.
Part 10. Religion and Culture. Shiraz has many mosques. People go to pray. Religion is important
in daily life. People are kind and respect traditions. Culture is very strong in Shiraz.
People like poetry, music, and art. You can see art in streets, museums, and gardens.
Traditional music is very common. People play instruments and sing songs about life and love.
Art is everywhere in the city. You can learn about the culture in Shiraz by talking to people.
They are proud of their history. Visiting Shiraz is not only about buildings.
It is about meeting people and understanding life. Part 11. Travel and Tourism. Many tourists
visit Shiraz every year. They come to see gardens, mosques, and tombs. Tourism is very important for
the city. Travel is easy. You can take taxis, buses, or walk in the city. Hotels are comfortable.
People help tourists find places. You can also take day trips from Shiraz.
There are mountains and villages nearby. Tourists can enjoy nature and history together.
Shiraz is safe and friendly. People like visitors. You can feel welcome in the city.
Traveling in Shiraz is fun and relaxing. You can see history, nature, and neat, nice people.
I am Emily. Shiraz is a beautiful city. It has history, gardens, friendly people, and tasty food.
You can visit old buildings, markets, and festivals. Shiraz is a city of poetry and art.
You can feel culture everywhere. People are kind and helpful.
I hope you can visit Shiraz one day. You will enjoy the city and meet nice people.
Goodbye. Or as they say in Persian, kudahafiz.
